title: Prove true capped paid law cannot rescue fixed degree23 certificate
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The true cap cannot rescue degree23 at the fixed `native-concentrated-balanced` witness. This closes PR5042's explicitly remaining capped-reference question using only the first two raw moments.

```text
cap correction <= 0.002146686937
required correction > 0.003093849703
  -> capped mean >= 0.857947162767
  -> j23 ratio > 0.020466198952 > capacity 0.019675906373
```

For any mean μ<1, the pointwise inequality `(x−1)+ <= (x−μ)²/[4(1−μ)]` bounds the tail expectation. Applying it to the actual paid iid260 law proves a strict highest-coefficient obstruction, even before adding nonnegative paid excess. The complete splitting plus full paid completion normalization remains intact. The result concerns the fixed beta and capped-reference certificate, not a lower bound on the actual completed law, compiler impossibility, or a new κ.

## Validation

- **Before:** PR5042 bounds the capped law by uncapped raw moments and explicitly leaves the true cap open. Its exact README is retained with head/path/SHA256 and attribution; none of its numerical results or code is needed for replay.
  **After:** Directed rational first/second moments and the analytic tail bound prove cap insufficiency; no capped high-moment calculation, tensor histogram, or parameter scan is performed.
- Normal and `-O` registered replay passed (~0.74s together), including independent exact cap-crossing fixtures, cap-before-average, tail-probability, omitted completion and inverted-normalization controls. The unchanged p24 source certificate passes.
- Metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history preflight, deterministic export integrity and Git-free exported replay passed. All live scientific inputs are available at canonical base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`.
- Credits: zxv's compiler/cap theorem/interval engine; Jacob Alan Sussman's integer compiler; PR4411/4414/4416/4433 and Cinna Davis's native lineage; JoyboyBrian PR5042. Prepared for JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new research package is added. Selected results and source implementations are unchanged. Higher capped moments, native/physical/outer admission, full multiplication proof, and alternative beta/certificates remain unrun or outside scope.

## Task and overlap

Refined `b2_math_capped_paid_law` / `independent-moment`, [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5013#discussioncomment-19140792). Scientific base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, priority revision7; canonical main refreshed unchanged. This changes the random variable from PR5042 uncapped raw reference to the truly capped iid260 reference. It does not repackage raw Bell/EGF moments, sweep parameters or optimize root digits. Exact heads and live source hashes are recorded in SOURCES.json.

## Open next questions

See [package questions](research/capped-paid-law-obstruction/README.md#open-next-questions): a different beta, actual paid law analysis or changed certificate lies outside this fixed-reference obstruction. No implied universal compiler barrier.

Reproduce on CPython3.12/macOS arm64: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/capped-paid-law-obstruction`. Independent Astra exact-head source/math review and normal/optimized checks pass without findings; no human or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.
